verdict.rationale: Gide has its own Employee Share Schemes page stating it designs, implements and monitors employee share ownership plans in France and internationally, with a combined legal, tax and employment team. A BSPCE taxation insight confirms depth on the French founder-warrant scheme. The story's named local schemes are not described on its pages, so coverage is partial. Missing for 10: any first-party description of UK EMI, German VSOP/ESOP or Indian ESOP work; detail on option-plan design beyond a general statement; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm designs employee equity programs — option plans and local schemes like UK EMI, German VSOP/ESOP, or Indian ESOPs — described on its own pages

citations.quote: We can help you design, implement and monitor your employee share ownership and executive remuneration plans, in France and internationally.
